input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: No exit provision exists anywhere in the Agreement. Section 14 (p0079) addresses only how long TrueLink keeps serving after a termination notice; Section 13 (p0078) puts the burden on us ("Client is responsible for arranging for a new name server within 30 days"; "a new hosting environment within 60 days") without any TrueLink migration assistance. Section 10 (Confidentiality) contains no return-or-destroy mechanic, and searches for transition, migration, export, return, delete/destroy turn up nothing (only the unrelated Y2K "transition" reference in p0060 and domain-name assistance in p0041). The Agreement therefore fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus a 30-day data export) and leaves our Client Content and borrower/loan data with the host on exit. We insert the preferred position in the termination article: up to six months' transition assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of our data within thirty days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. Section 24 (p0090) already makes Sections 5 through 30 survive termination, so the inserted obligation in Section 14 survives.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion obligations into Section 14 (Termination)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The agreement gives us no exit rights: nothing requires TrueLink to help us migrate or to return our site content and borrower data when hosting ends. We add our standard transition clause — up to six months' assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of our data within thirty days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter; we can live with 90 days' assistance and the same 30-day export as a fallback.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return all Client Content and other Client data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Client Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
